examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The second-level navigation of a resource detail page: a full-bleed strip ruled at the bottom, its tabs at the page boundary inset.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import PageTabs from '@aziontech/webkit/page-tabs'
  import Tabs from '@aziontech/webkit/tabs'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const activeTab = ref('overview')
  const tabs = [
    { value: 'overview', label: 'Overview' },
    { value: 'build', label: 'Build' },
    { value: 'deployments', label: 'Deployments' },
    { value: 'variables', label: 'Variables' },
    { value: 'rules', label: 'Rules' },
    { value: 'logs', label: 'Logs' },
    { value: 'metrics', label: 'Metrics' },
    { value: 'settings', label: 'Settings' }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <PageTabs v-model="activeTab">
    <Tabs.Item
      v-for="tab in tabs"
      :key="tab.value"
      :value="tab.value"
      :label="tab.label"
    />
  </PageTabs>
</template>

examples.name: WithActions
examples.summary: A service's detail tabs with the actions the resource owns on the right: the staged-changes Tag and the outlined medium Deploy button.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import PageTabs from '@aziontech/webkit/page-tabs'
  import Tabs from '@aziontech/webkit/tabs'
  import Tag from '@aziontech/webkit/tag'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const activeTab = ref('overview')
  const tabs = [
    { value: 'overview', label: 'Overview' },
    { value: 'deployments', label: 'Deployments' },
    { value: 'settings', label: 'Settings' }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <PageTabs v-model="activeTab">
    <Tabs.Item
      v-for="tab in tabs"
      :key="tab.value"
      :value="tab.value"
      :label="tab.label"
    />
    <template #actions>
      <Tag
        severity="warning"
        size="small"
        label="2 changes"
      />
      <Button
        label="Deploy"
        kind="outlined"
        size="medium"
        icon="pi pi-cloud-upload"
      />
    </template>
  </PageTabs>
</template>
